title: Treaty of Rapallo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Rapallo (1922)", at revision 1362703017, opens: "The Treaty of Rapallo was an agreement signed on 16 April 1922 between Germany and Russia under which both renounced all territorial and financial claims against each other and opened friendly diplomatic relations. The treaty was negotiated by Russian foreign minister Georgi Chicherin and German foreign minister Walther Rathenau. It was a major victory for Russia especially and also Germany, and a major disappointment to France and the United Kingdom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q155796, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1922 treaty between Germany and Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
